REFUSE_FROZEN.label: Payments are frozen
REFUSE_FROZEN.text: Payments are frozen, so this one was refused. Unfreezing needs your passkey and takes 24 hours.

REFUSE_UNVERIFIED_PAYEE.label: Recipient not verified
REFUSE_UNVERIFIED_PAYEE.text: The recipient has not been verified, so Kassa cannot pay it. Verify the recipient first.

REFUSE_SOURCE_MISMATCH.label: Source does not match
REFUSE_SOURCE_MISMATCH.text: The details came from a source that does not match the payment, so it was refused. Check the request with the recipient.

REFUSE_SANCTIONS.label: Blocked by sanctions check
REFUSE_SANCTIONS.text: This payment was blocked by a sanctions check. It cannot be paid through Kassa.

REFUSE_CAP.label: Over your limit
REFUSE_CAP.text: This payment is above one of your limits, so it was refused. Lower the amount or raise the limit with your passkey.

HANDOFF_REGION.label: Pay it yourself
HANDOFF_REGION.text: Because of your region, Kassa cannot send this payment. Pay it yourself using the handoff screen.

HANDOFF_MODE.label: Pay it yourself
HANDOFF_MODE.text: Your money mode is set to handoff, so you need to pay this one yourself from the handoff screen.

MANDATE_MATCH.label: Covered by a mandate
MANDATE_MATCH.text: This bill matches a mandate you signed, so it can be paid automatically within its limits.

MANDATE_OUT_OF_SCOPE.label: Outside your mandate
MANDATE_OUT_OF_SCOPE.text: This payment is outside the limits of your mandate, so it needs your passkey.

SMALL_AUTO.label: Small enough to auto-pay
SMALL_AUTO.text: This is under your auto-pay limit to a verified recipient, so Kassa can pay it without asking.

RISK_HIGH.label: Needs a closer look
RISK_HIGH.text: The rules see something unusual about this payment, so they ask you to approve it.

AGENT_REQUESTED_CONFIRM.label: Kassa asked for approval
AGENT_REQUESTED_CONFIRM.text: Kassa asked for your approval before it goes ahead, so nothing is paid until you sign it.

PRESET_ASK_ME.label: Your preset asks first
PRESET_ASK_ME.text: You chose Ask me, so every payment needs your passkey.

CAP_WITHIN_2X_ASK.label: Close to your limit
CAP_WITHIN_2X_ASK.text: This payment is close to your limit, so the rules ask you to confirm it.

PAYEE_COOLING.label: Recipient is cooling down
PAYEE_COOLING.text: This recipient is new or changed, so it cools down for 24 hours before it can be paid.

PAYEE_ACCOUNT_MISSING.label: Recipient details needed
PAYEE_ACCOUNT_MISSING.text: Kassa does not have this recipient's account details yet, so it cannot pay them. Add the recipient's details first.

TRIGGER_ORIGIN.label: Started from a message
TRIGGER_ORIGIN.text: This payment came from a message or notification, so it needs your approval before it goes ahead.

TRIGGER_NEEDS_MANDATE.label: Needs your approval
TRIGGER_NEEDS_MANDATE.text: This was started automatically (not by you), so it only pays on its own inside a mandate you signed.

AUTO_NOT_ELIGIBLE.label: Not eligible for auto-pay
AUTO_NOT_ELIGIBLE.text: Auto-pay needs Smart mode, a verified recipient, a capped wallet and signed base rules, and one of these is missing.

ABOVE_SMALL_AUTO_LIMIT.label: Above auto-pay limit
ABOVE_SMALL_AUTO_LIMIT.text: The amount is above your auto-pay limit, so it needs your passkey.

READER_SOURCE_MISMATCH.label: Document source mismatch
READER_SOURCE_MISMATCH.text: The document does not come from the sender it names, so Kassa will not use its details.

READER_FIELD_UNVERIFIED.label: Detail could not be checked
READER_FIELD_UNVERIFIED.text: One of the details in this document could not be verified, so please check it before you pay.

APPROVAL_EXPIRED.label: Approval expired
APPROVAL_EXPIRED.text: Your approval ran out before it was used, so nothing was paid. Review the order and approve it again.

ORDER_EXPIRED.label: Order expired
ORDER_EXPIRED.text: This order is no longer valid, so nothing was paid. Ask Kassa for a new one.

BAD_SIGNATURE.label: Signature did not check out
BAD_SIGNATURE.text: The passkey signature could not be verified, so nothing was paid. Try approving again.

ORDER_HASH_MISMATCH.label: Order changed after signing
ORDER_HASH_MISMATCH.text: The order is not the same as the one you signed, so nothing was paid. Review it again.

ASSERTION_INVALID.label: Passkey check failed
ASSERTION_INVALID.text: Your passkey response was not accepted, so nothing was paid. Try again.

USER_NOT_VERIFIED.label: Passkey not verified
USER_NOT_VERIFIED.text: Your passkey was not verified for this action, so nothing was paid.

COUNTER_REGRESSION.label: Passkey out of date
COUNTER_REGRESSION.text: This passkey response is older than the last one, so it was refused for safety. Try again.

NO_APPROVAL.label: No approval found
NO_APPROVAL.text: Kassa did not find your approval for this payment, so nothing was paid.

NONCE_USED.label: Approval already used
NONCE_USED.text: This approval was already used, so it cannot be used again. Nothing was paid twice.

MANDATE_INACTIVE.label: Mandate not active
MANDATE_INACTIVE.text: The mandate for this bill is not active yet or has been revoked, so it cannot pay automatically.

PAYMENTS_DAILY_CAP.label: Daily limit reached
PAYMENTS_DAILY_CAP.text: You have reached your daily payment limit, so this payment waits until tomorrow or until you raise the limit.

QR_PAYEE_MISMATCH.label: QR name does not match
QR_PAYEE_MISMATCH.text: The name in the QR code does not match the verified recipient, so Kassa will not let you pay it.

CARD_ALREADY_USED.label: Card already used
CARD_ALREADY_USED.text: This one-time card was already used, so it cannot be charged again.

CARD_EXPIRED.label: Card expired
CARD_EXPIRED.text: The card for this payment has expired, so it was not charged. Ask Kassa to try again.

MERCHANT_MISMATCH.label: Merchant does not match
MERCHANT_MISMATCH.text: The merchant does not match the payment you approved, so nothing was charged.

AMOUNT_OVER_LIMIT.label: Amount over card limit
AMOUNT_OVER_LIMIT.text: The amount is more than the card allows, so nothing was charged.

CURRENCY_MISMATCH.label: Currency does not match
CURRENCY_MISMATCH.text: The currency does not match the payment you approved, so nothing was charged.

RAIL_ERROR.label: Payment provider problem
RAIL_ERROR.text: The payment provider failed or could not be reached, so nothing was confirmed. Try again later.

LOOSEN_PENDING.label: Change waiting for delay
LOOSEN_PENDING.text: A change that loosens a rule is still waiting for its 24-hour delay to end.

PASSKEY_REQUIRED.label: Passkey needed
PASSKEY_REQUIRED.text: This change needs your passkey before it can be made.

WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID.label: Update could not be trusted
WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID.text: A payment update failed its signature check, so Kassa ignored it.

WEBHOOK_REPLAY_WINDOW.label: Old update ignored
WEBHOOK_REPLAY_WINDOW.text: A payment update arrived too late to trust, so Kassa ignored it.

WEBHOOK_REPLAYED.label: Repeated update ignored
WEBHOOK_REPLAYED.text: A payment update was sent a second time, so Kassa ignored the copy.

USER_REJECTED.label: You rejected it
USER_REJECTED.text: You rejected this order, so nothing was sent.

AI_CONSENT_REQUIRED.label: AI consent needed
AI_CONSENT_REQUIRED.text: Kassa's assistant is an AI. Agree to AI processing in Settings > Privacy before chatting with it.

PROCESSING_RESTRICTED.label: Processing restricted
PROCESSING_RESTRICTED.text: You restricted processing of your data, so Kassa keeps it but does not use it. Lift the restriction by unfreezing with your passkey.

ACCOUNT_ERASED.label: Account erased
ACCOUNT_ERASED.text: This account was erased at your request. Its personal data can no longer be read.

UNFREEZE_PENDING.label: Unfreeze pending
UNFREEZE_PENDING.text: Unfreezing is a loosening, so it takes effect 24 hours after you confirmed it with your passkey.

RATE_LIMITED.label: Too many attempts
RATE_LIMITED.text: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.

INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS.label: Not enough money
INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS.text: None of your balances can cover this payment and its fees in time, so nothing was sent. Add money or convert first, then try again.

DUPLICATE_OBLIGATION_PAYMENT.label: Already being paid
DUPLICATE_OBLIGATION_PAYMENT.text: This bill for this period is already paid or waiting for your approval, so a second payment was refused.

KYC_REQUIRED.label: Identity check needed
KYC_REQUIRED.text: This amount needs a verified identity first, so it was refused. Complete the identity check in Settings, then try again.

FUNDING_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.label: Account no longer linked
FUNDING_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.text: The card or bank account you chose to pay from is no longer linked, so nothing was sent.

FUNDING_PULL_DECLINED.label: Declined
FUNDING_PULL_DECLINED.text: Your linked card or bank declined the payment, so nothing was sent. Try another account or your Kassa wallet.

FUNDING_ABOVE_SIGNED_MAX.label: Price changed
FUNDING_ABOVE_SIGNED_MAX.text: The bank asked for more than the maximum you signed, so nothing was sent. Review the new amount and sign again.

MANDATE_SCOPE_MISMATCH.label: Not covered by your autopay
MANDATE_SCOPE_MISMATCH.text: This recipient is in one of your autopay mandates, but this payment is not the bill you signed the mandate for (or it is a different amount), so it needs your passkey.

SMALL_AUTO_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.label: Daily auto-pay limit used
SMALL_AUTO_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.text: Kassa already paid the most small amounts it may pay on its own today, so this one needs your passkey.

PIPL_CONSENT_REQUIRED.label: Cross-border consent needed
PIPL_CONSENT_REQUIRED.text: You are in region CN and Kassa's AI runs outside mainland China. Under China's PIPL this needs your separate consent: give it in Settings > Privacy > Cross-border AI processing before using the assistant.

INVOICE_ABOVE_PO.label: Invoice above order
INVOICE_ABOVE_PO.text: The supplier's invoice is for more than the purchase order you signed, so it was refused. Ask the supplier for a corrected invoice.

INVOICE_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH.label: Invoice account changed
INVOICE_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH.text: The invoice asks you to pay an account that is not the supplier's verified account, so it was refused. Check with the supplier by phone before paying anything.

PO_NOT_DELIVERED.label: Not delivered yet
PO_NOT_DELIVERED.text: This purchase order has not been delivered yet, so its invoice cannot be paid.

PO_ABOVE_FORECAST.label: Larger than forecast
PO_ABOVE_FORECAST.text: This purchase order is much larger than your stock forecast suggests, so it needs your passkey.
